Homebase FAQs
What is Homebase?
Homebase is the everything app for small businesses with hourly teams. Homebase connects employee scheduling, time tracking, and payroll in one workflow — plus hiring and onboarding, HR and compliance, and team communication — all in one mobile-first app, built for hourly, shift-based small businesses like restaurants, retail, beauty and wellness, medical, and home services.
How does Homebase work?
Homebase combines time tracking, scheduling, payroll, team messaging, hiring, and HR tools all in one place, so you can spend less time on admin work and more time running your business. You build and share employee schedules, your team clocks in and out from a mobile or tablet time clock (with PIN, photo, and GPS/geofencing verification), and Homebase tracks hours in real time. It automatically flags missed punches, breaks, and overtime to keep you compliant and cut down on errors. When it's time to pay, those accurate hours flow straight into payroll—so everything from clock-in to payday happens in one place, with no manual re-entry.
Is Homebase free?
Yes, the Homebase Basic plan is genuinely free — no credit card required, no trial period. You get scheduling, time tracking, team messaging, and POS connections for up to 10 employees at one location. It's not a stripped-down preview; it's a fully functional starting point for small teams. When you're ready for more — GPS time tracking, auto-scheduling, labor cost forecasting, or payroll — paid plans start at $30/month per location.
We also offer a 14-day trial of our All-In-One plan if you want to test the full feature set before committing to anything, so you can get set up and running before money ever enters the picture.
How much does Homebase cost?
The cost you'll pay for Homebase depends on what your team needs. Our free plan covers one location with up to 10 people, and a small business can run on that without ever paying.
Once you outgrow that, there are paid plans billed at a flat monthly rate per location. You can see what's included in each plan on our Pricing page , but here's a quick summary:
The Essentials plan gives you advanced scheduling, time off management, team messaging, and payroll integrations.
With the Plus plan you get additional features like AI-powered scheduling and advanced PTO tracking.
The All-in-One plan layers in employee onboarding, HR support, labor cost management, and compliance tools.
You can also add Payroll, Task Management, and Tip Management to any plan.
Does Homebase offer payroll?
Yes, Homebase offers full-service payroll including automated tax filing, direct deposit, W-2 and 1099 filing, contractor payments, and tip pooling for hourly teams. It's built directly into the same app you use for scheduling and time tracking. Approved hours flow straight into payroll — no exporting files, no re-entering data. Wages, overtime, tips, and taxes are all calculated automatically, and federal, state, and local tax filings are handled for you.
Homebase has processed over 7 million paychecks and $5 billion in gross payroll since 2022, and 84% of customers report faster payroll processing after switching. It's been recognized as Best Payroll for Hourly Teams by CNN Underscored and Best Small Business Payroll by U.S. News 360 Reviews. Pricing is straightforward: $49/month plus $6 per employee.
How does Homebase compare to other team management software?
Homebase is an all-in-one app for hourly teams that combines scheduling, time tracking, team messaging, hiring, HR, and payroll in one place, priced per location instead of per employee. In contrast, most Homebase competitors are point solutions. They're strong at one thing, like scheduling, time tracking, or team communication, but you end up stitching several tools together to get the solution you need.
Another differentiator is Homebase's native payroll: hours flow straight from the time clock into payroll, with automatic tax filing, direct deposit, and tip distribution built in. Many alternatives either lack payroll entirely or run it through a third party you pay and manage separately.
Homebase also offers a free, fully functional plan for one location with up to 10 team members, and works for any hourly business—restaurants, retail, salons, healthcare—not just one vertical.
You can see more about how Homebase compares to competitors here.

Questions? We’ve got time.
What does a location mean?
A location is a physical address that is your place of business. It is where you carry out your business operations. You may have one or more than one location depending on your business. Multiple locations within the same city are still considered as multiple locations as long as they have separate physical addresses. Examples: If you have a restaurant business that serves out of two different addresses, you have two locations If you are an online business with only one physical location, you have one location We have a Basic plan that is free for teams up to 10 employees and operating in one location. If you operate in more than one location, you can try our Essentials, Plus or AiO plans that allow you to manage the complexity of running multiple locations at the same time, from one place.
How many employees can I have on Homebase?
Our plans and tools are suited for all teams of all sizes – whether big or small. We have a Basic plan that is free for teams of up to 10 employees and operating in one location. However, we do recommend starting with the Essentials plan to make the most of our best in class shift planning & time tracking solutions. If you are managing a team of more than 10 employees or are expecting to grow your team significantly in the upcoming months, it is best to sign up to the Plus plan to get access to Hiring & Team Retention & Performance Tracking tools!
Is payroll available on all plans?
Yes! Payroll is available as an add-on product on all plans for a standard $49 base fee / month + $6 per employee paid / month no matter which Homebase plan you choose. Combining a Homebase plan with Payroll lets you run payroll in minutes – no kidding. With integrated time-tracking, Homebase can calculate your team’s wages, make direct payments and automatically file taxes.
Can I upgrade or downgrade later if I change my mind?
Yes! We understand that exploring a new product can take time, especially when you’re in the thick of running a small business. You can change your Homebase plan at any time – and the newly chosen plan will get activated at the start of the next billing cycle.
What happens after the free All-in-One 14-day trial?
If you don’t have any plan selected at the end of your 14-day free All-in-One trial, you will automatically be switched to the free Basic Plan. If you have a team of more than 10 employees or have more than one location, you will be asked to sign up for either the Essentials, Plus or All-in-One plan.

Pioneer Works, Inc., Homebase Services, LLC, and any of its affiliates or related entities (“ Pioneer Works ”, “ Homebase ”, “ we ”, “ us ” and/or “ our ”) is committed to protecting your privacy and earning your trust. This Privacy Policy discloses our privacy practices for personal information we collect when you use or access our products, services, features, or content, provided directly or under the name “Homebase”, whether through any Homebase website (the “Site” ) or any Homebase application or service (“ Services ”).
PLEASE REVIEW THIS PRIVACY POLICY CAREFULLY. BY ACCESSING THE PIONEER WORKS WEBSITE OR ANY PIONEER WORKS APPLICATION, YOU SIGNIFY ACCEPTANCE OF THIS PRIVACY POLICY.
IF YOU DO NOT AGREE WITH THIS PRIVACY POLICY, PLEASE DO NOT ACCESS THE SITE OR ANY APPLICATION.
Changes To Our Policy:
We may, in our sole discretion, change this Privacy Policy from time to time by posting a revised version at https://app.joinhomebase.com/privacy . If we make any material change to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you by posting a notice on https://app.joinhomebase.com/privacy prior to the change becoming effective and may also elect to send you an email notifying you of the Privacy Policy modifications.
Information We Collect:
When you interact with us through the Services, we may collect personal and other information from you, as further described below. This includes information you provide to us, information which is collected about you automatically, and information we obtain from third parties.
Pioneer Works may collect the following information from you:
Identifiers, such as name, address, email, phone number, online identifier, Internet Protocol (IP) address, device information, information collected from cookies or other tracking technology, and other similar identifiers.
Customer records such as social security number, tax identification number, date of birth, employment, and education.
Demographic information, such as age and gender.
Financial information, such as bank account number, credit or debit card number, and other financial information.
Commercial information, such as purchase history and engagement with the Services.
Information from third parties, such as personal information stored with third parties that you choose to provide to us. By linking your third-party accounts, you authorize Pioneer Works to have access to this information and you agree that Pioneer Works may collect and use this information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
Internet, device and browsing activity, such as browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.
Usage data, such as the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.
Information you provide to us when interacting with our customer support team or other team members via email, phone, live chat, or other correspondence.
Geolocation information, which we may obtain when using mobile versions of our Services, which helps us offer features such as time clock usage, or alerts for scheduled shifts or breaks, or other jobs that might be nearby and of interest to you.
Inferences, including information about your interests and preferences.
Earned wage access information, if you use our earned wage access feature. This includes hours worked and payroll data used to calculate your accrued but unpaid wages, the amount and timing of your requests, the deposit account you designate to receive funds and from which repayment is collected, and your repayment history.
We collect personal data directly from you, and in some cases from recruitment companies, references, and background check companies. This information may include personal data included in your resume, assessment responses, and background check results (compliant with applicable law). Additionally, we collect any other personal data you choose to share, such as recordings of your interviews or assessments, if you consent.
When you interact with Pioneer Works through the Site and Services, we receive and store certain personally non-identifiable information. Such information, which is collected passively using various technologies, cannot presently be used to specifically identify you. Pioneer Works may store such information itself or such information may be included in databases owned and maintained by Pioneer Works affiliates, agents or service providers. The Services may use such information and pool it with other information to track, for example, the total number of visitors to our Site, the number of visitors to each page of our Site, and the domain names of our visitors' Internet service providers. It is important to note that no personal information is available or used in this process.
How We Use Your Information:
Pioneer Works collects your personal information as reasonably necessary and proportionate to provide you with the Site and Services. Your personal information is used for the following specific purposes:
Provide the Services to you.
Provide notifications to you about your activity within the Services.
Provide customer support when you contact us to resolve any questions or issues.
Notify you about important changes to the Site, Services, and/or changes to Pioneer Work’s Terms of Service/EULA, or Privacy Policy.
Monitor and improve your experience with the Site and Services.
Engage in marketing activities, based on your communication preferences, and as permitted by applicable law.
Ensure network and information security and prevent other abusive or illicit activity of the Site or Services.
Process payments and collect fees.
Determine your eligibility for earned wage access, calculate the amount available to you, verify your identity, disburse requested funds, and collect repayment from the account you designate.
Market our products to you by email and push notification..
To evaluate your job application and communicate with you about it, we will review and assess your candidacy.
To enable your company to become a Homebase partner/integrate with Homebase.
To fulfill our contractual obligations, maintain communication with service providers, and adhere to legal and record-keeping requirements.
For any other purpose we disclose to you in the course of providing the Site or Services to you.
How We Use Artificial Intelligence:
Pioneer Works uses artificial intelligence tools in certain features of the Services. These tools process personal information to generate recommendations, rankings, drafts, alerts, forecasts, and other outputs. For example, our use of AI may include, but is not limited to, the following areas:
Scheduling and workforce management, such as generating scheduling recommendations, optimizing shift assignments, or flagging scheduling conflicts.
Hiring assistance, such as screening, scoring, ranking, summarizing, or drafting content to assist employers with applicant evaluation. As described in our Terms of Service/EULA, the employer, not Homebase, makes all hiring decisions.
Customer support, including AI-powered chatbots and automated response tools. Where you are interacting with an AI system, we will disclose this.
Platform improvements, including analyzing usage patterns, detecting anomalies, preventing fraud, and improving the Services.
How We Use Your Data in Connection with AI:
When you or your employer use the Services, we collect and process data, including data that may identify or be reasonably linkable to specific individuals, to operate, improve, and develop the Services. This includes:
AI model training. We may use data submitted through the Services to train, test, and improve our AI models. This may include data linked to specific individuals. We apply technical and organizational safeguards when processing identifiable personal information for AI model training, as described in our Terms of Service/EULA.
Data Products. We may create analytics, benchmarking reports, forecasts, workforce insights, and other data-derived works ("Data Products") using data from the Services in aggregated, de-identified, anonymized, or transformed form. Pioneer Works owns all rights in Data Products.
Lawful Basis for Processing:
Pioneer Works processes personal information under the following legal bases:
Contractual Necessity: We process your personal information to perform the contract we have with you, including:
Providing the Services you've requested
Processing payments
Sending service notifications
Responding to your inquiries
Legitimate Interests: We process your personal information for our legitimate interests, including:
Improving and developing our Services
Protecting against fraud and abuse
Marketing our Services to existing customers
Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience
Consent: Where required by law, we process your personal information based on your consent, including:
Marketing communications to prospective customers
Collection and use of certain cookies
Processing of sensitive personal information
You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at privacyrequest@joinhomebase.com.
Legal Obligation: We process your personal information to comply with legal obligations, including:
Tax and accounting requirements
Data protection laws
Government requests and court orders
How We Share Your Information:
Pioneer Works may share your personal information for the following purposes:
With Pioneer Works subsidiaries and affiliates to help us improve the content and functionality of the Services and better understand our users.
With service providers to provide, maintain, and improve the Services, including analytics and marketing services, information technology and network services, and payment processors. These companies are authorized to use your personal information only as necessary to provide these services to us.
Pioneer Works may disclose your personal information if required to do so by law or in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to (i) comply with a legal obligation, (ii) protect and defend the rights or property of Pioneer Works, (iii) act in urgent circumstances to protect the personal safety of users of the Services or the public, or (iv) protect against legal liability.
Pioneer Works may also share aggregated, non-personally identifiable information with third parties for auditing, analytics, maintenance, security, or other related business purposes as determined appropriate by Pioneer Works.
As Pioneer Works develops our business, we might sell or buy businesses or assets. In the event of a corporate sale, merger, reorganization, dissolution or similar event, your personal information may be part of the transferred assets.
Other than as stated in this Privacy Policy, Pioneer Works does not disclose or sell any of your personal information to third parties without your consent. Notwithstanding anything in this Privacy Policy to the contrary, Pioneer Works reserves the right to collect, use, retain or sell de-identified or aggregated non-personally identifiable information and data obtained from use of the Site and Services.
Our Role as a Service Provider:
Pioneer Works provides the Services to businesses ("Employers") for use in managing their workforce. When an Employer uses the Services to process personal information about its employees or applicants, Pioneer Works acts as a service provider on behalf of that Employer.
If you are an employee or applicant whose personal information has been submitted by an Employer, the Employer is responsible for providing you with notice about how your information is used, obtaining required consents, and responding to your data requests in connection with your employment. We encourage you to direct questions to the Employer first. If the Employer is unable to address your request, you may contact us at privacyrequest@joinhomebase.com.
Text Message Communications:
We use text messaging to communicate with you about your service. Normal messaging rates apply and the frequency of messages may vary. Pioneer Works and/or mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All other categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
Exclusions:
This Privacy Policy does not apply to any personal information collected by Pioneer Works other than personal information collected through the Services. This Privacy Policy shall not apply to any unsolicited information you provide to Pioneer Works through the Services or through any other means. This includes, but is not limited to, information posted to any public areas of the Services, such as forums, any ideas for new products or modifications to existing products, and other unsolicited submissions (collectively, “Unsolicited Information”). All Unsolicited Information shall be deemed to be non-confidential, and Pioneer Works shall be free to reproduce, use, disclose, and distribute such Unsolicited Information to others without limitation or attribution.
Children’s Personal Information:
Pioneer Work’s Site is a general audience website and we do not intentionally collect or process personal information from children under the age of thirteen (13). If a child under 13 submits personal information to Pioneer Works Site and we learn that the information is from a child under 13 and the personal information was received without consent from the child’s parent or legal guardian, we will attempt to delete the information. If you are a parent or guardian and you believe we have processed personal information of your child under 13, please contact us via the Contact Us information below.
How We Use Cookies:
When you access our Site, we, or companies we hire to track how our website is used, may place small data files called “cookies” on your computer. We and our service providers also use cookies to customize the Services, content and advertising; measure promotional effectiveness, and promote trust and safety.
A cookie is a small piece of data that a website asks your browser to store on your computer or mobile device. The cookie allows the website to “remember” your actions or preferences over time. Most browsers support cookies, but you can set your browser to decline them and can delete them whenever you like.
Overall, cookies help us provide you with a better Site, by enabling us to monitor which pages you find useful and which you do not. A cookie in no way gives us access to your computer or any information about you, other than the data you choose to share with us. You can obtain more information about cookies by visiting http://www.allaboutcookies.org .
What Types of Cookies We Use:
We may use the following types of cookies to provide our Site and Services:
Essential Cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Function Cookies are cookies that enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Performance Cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Targeting Cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Opting Out of Cookie Usage:
If you want to control which cookies you accept, you can configure your browser to accept all cookies or to alert you every time a cookie is offered by a website's server. Most browsers automatically accept cookies.
You can set your browser option so that you will not receive cookies and you can also delete existing cookies from your browser. You may find that some parts of the site will not function properly if you have refused cookies.
You may opt out of these cookies using our consent management settings provided by our service provider. You will find a “My Privacy Choices” section in the footer. Please refer to this section for information on the cookies we use and how to opt out of certain cookies. We recommend that you leave cookies turned on because they allow you to take advantage of some features of the Site and Services.
Opting Out of Marketing Communications:
If at any time you wish not to receive any future marketing communications or you wish to have your name deleted from our mailing lists, please contact us through our help portal on our website.
Opting Out of Text Message Communications:
You may opt-out of text messaging at any time by replying to any message with STOP. This will end the communications from that particular phone number. You may continue to receive service-related and other non-marketing text messages from other phone numbers managed by us, and you may opt out of those in a similar fashion.
Opting Out of Push Notifications:
If you have installed our mobile application, we may send you service notifications about your account and activity, and marketing notifications about our products. You may turn off marketing push notifications at any time by disabling notifications for the application in your device settings.
Aggregated Personal Information:
In an ongoing effort to better understand and serve the users of the Services, Pioneer Works often conducts research on its customer demographics, interests and behavior based on the personal information and other information provided to us. This research may be compiled and analyzed on an aggregate basis, and Pioneer Works may share this aggregate data with its affiliates, agents and business partners. This aggregate information does not identify you personally. Pioneer Works may also disclose aggregated user statistics in order to describe our services to current and prospective business partners, and to other third parties for other lawful purposes.
How We Protect Your Information:
The security of your personal information is important to us, and we implement and maintain reasonable, commercially acceptable security procedures and practices in order to protect it from unauthorized access, use, modification, or disclosure. Our measures include firewalls, data encryption, SSL encryption, physical and electronic access controls, and strict rules regarding the access and use of data on our system. However, please be aware that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure and we are unable to guarantee the absolute security of information we have collected from you.
Data Retention and Disposal:
We will retain your Personal Information for as long as it is necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including to fulfill your requests or inquiries or provide Services. Your Personal Information may be stored for longer periods where required by legal, regulatory, business compliance, account owner, tax or accounting requirements; to maintain accurate records of your dealings with us in case of complaints or challenges; or if we believe there is a prospect of litigation relating to your Personal Information or dealings. We have a data retention policy to ensure Personal Data is not retained indefinitely.

Records of financial transactions, including earned wage access requests, disbursements, and repayments, are retained for the periods required by applicable financial services laws and licensing requirements, and may be retained after a deletion request

How To Update Your Information:
You may update, correct, or delete your account information and preferences at any time by accessing your account settings page on the Service. Please note that while any changes you make will be reflected in active user databases instantly or within a reasonable period of time, we may retain all information you submit for backups, archiving, prevention of fraud and abuse, analytics, satisfaction of legal obligations, or where we otherwise reasonably believe that we have a legitimate reason to do so. If we receive a request under this provision, we will acknowledge it within seventy-two (72) business hours and handle it in most cases within forty-five (45) days. Homebase can extend the time to respond by a further forty-five (45) calendar days if reasonably necessary.
If you are otherwise unable to update your information via the account settings page, please contact our customer support team. We will take reasonable steps to update, remove or correct your information in our possession that you have previously submitted via the Services.
Declining To Share Your Information:
You may decline to share certain personal information with us, in which case we may not be able to provide to you some of the features and functionality of the Service enabled by the provision of such personal information. Pioneer Works will not discriminate against you for exercising any rights you may have under applicable federal or state law.
Rights for California Residents:
In addition to the rights provided for above, if you are a California resident, you have the following additional rights:
The right to know: The categories of personal information we have collected about you;
The categories of sources from which the personal information was collected;
The categories of personal information about you we disclosed for a business purpose or sold;
The categories of third parties to whom the personal information was disclosed for a business purpose or sold;
The business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling the Personal Data; and
The specific pieces of Personal Data we have collected about you.
The right to request we delete personal information we have collected about you. In certain instances, Pioneer Works may have legal requirements which require we keep such data.
The right to opt-out of the sharing of your personal information with third parties providing cross-context behavioral advertising.
The right to limit the use and disclosure of your sensitive personal information to those purposes permitted under California law.
The right to correct inaccurate personal information we maintain about you
We will not share any personal information with third parties for their direct marketing purposes to the extent prohibited by California law. If our practices change, we will do so in accordance with applicable law and will notify you in advance.
To exercise any of these rights, please submit a request through our help portal on our website or at privacyrequest@joinhomebase.com . In the request, please specify which right you are seeking to exercise and the scope of the request. We may require specific information from you to help us verify your identity and process your request. If we are unable to verify your identity, we may deny your requests to know or delete. Once we have received a verifiable request, we will respond in a timely manner consistent with applicable law.
Rights for United States Residents:
In addition to the rights described elsewhere in this Privacy Policy, residents of certain U.S. states have additional rights under their state's privacy law. If you are a resident of a state with an applicable law, you may have the right to:
Access your personal information and obtain a copy.
Request deletion of your personal information.
Correct inaccurate personal information.
Receive your data in a portable format.
Opt out of targeted advertising, sale of personal information, and profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
Authorized Agent. You can designate an authorized agent to submit requests on your behalf. However, we will require written proof of the agent’s permission to do so and verify your identity directly.
Right of No Retaliation. Pioneer Works will not retaliate against you should you choose to exercise your rights. Specifically, Pioneer Works will not charge you different prices for services, provide a different level or quality of services, or deny you services, except where such exercise would prevent Pioneer Works from obtaining, using, or sharing personal information which is necessary to perform the services reasonably expected.
Rights for Canadian Residents:
Pioneer Works complies with Canadian privacy laws, including PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act). If you are a Canadian resident, you have the following rights regarding your personal information:
Consent Requirements:
We obtain meaningful consent for the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information
You can withdraw consent at any time, subject to legal or contractual restrictions
We explain the consequences of withdrawing consent
Access and Correction Rights:
You have the right to access your personal information in our custody or control
You can request information about how we use and share your personal information
You can challenge the accuracy and completeness of your personal information
We will correct or amend inaccurate or incomplete information as required
If we disagree with your request for correction, we will note your disagreement in our records
Cross-Border Data Transfers:
Your personal information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in countries outside Canada
While your information is in another jurisdiction, it may be accessed by courts, law enforcement, and national security authorities according to the laws of that jurisdiction
We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place when transferring data across borders
We maintain comparable levels of protection for your information when processed outside Canada
Data Breach Notification:
We will notify you of any breach of security safeguards involving your personal information if it creates a real risk of significant harm
We will also notify the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada and other relevant regulatory authorities
Notifications will be given as soon as feasible after we determine a breach has occurred
Complaint Resolution:
You can file a complaint about our privacy practices by contacting our Privacy Team at privacyrequest@joinhomebase.com
If we receive a request under this provision, we will acknowledge it within seventy-two (72) business hours and handle it in most cases within forty-five (45) days. Homebase can extend the time to respond by a further forty-five (45) calendar days if reasonably necessary
If you are not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
You can reach the Office of the Privacy Commissioner at www.priv.gc.ca or 1-800-282-1376
Additional Protections:
We limit collection to information that is necessary for identified purposes
We protect personal information with security safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information
We are transparent about our privacy practices and management of personal information
We provide clear and easily accessible privacy notices
We respond to privacy inquiries and requests in a timely manner
Business Contact Exception:
Under PIPEDA, certain information about business customers or employees (such as name, title, business address, and business phone number) may be collected, used, or disclosed without consent when used solely for business communications.
Links to Other Websites:
This Privacy Policy applies only to the Services. The Services may contain links to other websites not operated or controlled by Pioneer Works (the “ Third-Party Sites ”). The policies and procedures we described here do not apply to the Third-Party Sites. The links from the Services do not imply that Pioneer Works endorses or has reviewed the Third-Party Sites. We suggest contacting those sites directly for information on their privacy policies.
Contacting Pioneer Works:
Please also feel free to contact us if you have any questions about Pioneer Works’ Privacy Policy or the information practices of the Services.
You may contact us through our help section of our website
You may also send us a written notice to:
